events.evidence: The Taliban seize control of the provincial capital of Kunduz in northern Afghanistan
An Arab coalition air-strike on a wedding party in Wahijah, a village near the Red Sea port city of Mocha in southern Yemen, reportedly leaves as many as 131 people dead
Separatists won a clear majority of seats in Catalonia's parliament

label.note: Kunduz fall, deadly Yemen strike and Catalan separatist win raise geopolitical risk.
